cover.title: 5 Apps for a GLP-1 Cut
cover.subtitle: The scale can't tell fat from muscle. These can.

apps.name: Shotsy
apps.description: Keeps your GLP-1 schedule on track — doses, injection sites, and how each week makes you feel. The med side, handled.
Appetite gone on a GLP-1? Cal AI makes it effortless to log meals and hit protein, so you lose fat, not muscle.
The scale drops on a GLP-1 — but is it fat or muscle? GainFrame reads both from a photo, so you know what you're losing.
Muscle is what you protect on a cut. Hevy makes resistance training easy to log and progress, so you hold onto it.
As appetite and weight fall, MacroFactor recalculates your targets each week — so your plan keeps pace with a shrinking intake.

caption: 5 apps for losing weight on a GLP-1 without losing muscle 💉 The scale can't tell fat from muscle — but #3 can. GainFrame reads your body-fat % and muscle from a single photo, so you know the weight you're dropping is fat, not the muscle you worked for. Track the shot, the protein, and the result.
